data.text: **Question:** What is middleware in ASP.NET Core?
Middleware are components in the request pipeline that handle requests and responses. Each can perform operations before and after the next component.
Middleware form a pipeline that processes HTTP requests. Each middleware can short-circuit or pass to next. Order matters. Built-in middleware include routing, authentication, static files.
